test_cases.description: Verifies state/alphabet preservation, direct transition output assignment lambda'(q, a) = lambda(dest), and strict output equivalence.

test_cases.feature: Mealy to Moore state splitting (Sequence Detector '101')
test_cases.description: State q1 receives incoming outputs 0 and 1, forcing state splitting into q1_0 and q1_1. Tests correct split transition mapping and equivalence.
Tests bit inversion where every input bit x is replaced by ~x. Verifies output behavior is preserved across multiple bit sequences.
Tests memory of first '1' bit, ensuring states retain output behavior across conversion.
Moore machine outputs lambda(q0) of length 1, while Mealy outputs empty string of length 0. Preserves Moore(ε) = lambda(q0) · Mealy(ε).
A single-state Mealy machine with self-loops having multiple outputs (0 and 1) splits correctly into two Moore states.
Ensures that candidate split states that cannot be reached from the new start state are properly detected and pruned.
Ensures the simulator rejects invalid characters with a descriptive error rather than undefined runtime crash.
Fails validation if any state has undefined transition delta(q, a) according to the project guidance rules.
Stress-tests conversion on long strings to verify zero divergence in output behaviour across 50 steps.
